intervals_greedy_nonoverlappingintervals.title: Erase Overlap Intervals
intervals_greedy_nonoverlappingintervals.problem: Given a list of intervals, return the minimum number to remove so the rest don't overlap (touching endpoints are fine). Example: [[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[1,3]] -> 1 (remove [1,3]).

dp_lis_longestincreasingsubsequence_v2.p.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS)
dp_lis_longestincreasingsubsequence_v2.p.problem: Given an integer array, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence (not necessarily contiguous). Example: [10,9,2,5,3,7,101,18] -> 4 ([2,3,7,101]).

dp_tabulation_distinctsubsequences.png.title: Distinct Subsequences
dp_tabulation_distinctsubsequences.png.problem: Given strings s and t, count how many distinct subsequences of s equal t. Example: s='rabbbit', t='rabbit' -> 3 (delete any one of the three b's).

bitmanip_fulladder_sumoftwointegers.png.title: Sum of Two Integers
bitmanip_fulladder_sumoftwointegers.png.problem: Return a + b without using the + or - operators. Example: a=1, b=2 -> 3; a=-2, b=3 -> 1.

dp_tabulation_mincostclimbingstairs.png.title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
dp_tabulation_mincostclimbingstairs.png.problem: cost[i] is the price of stepping on stair i; you may start at stair 0 or 1 and climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return the minimum cost to reach the top (just past the last stair). Example: [10,15,20] -> 15.

dp_tabulation_editdistance.png.title: Edit Distance
dp_tabulation_editdistance.png.problem: Given word1 and word2, return the minimum number of single-character inserts, deletes, or replaces to turn word1 into word2. Example: 'horse' -> 'ros' takes 3.

dp_tabulation_jumpgame2_v2.png.title: Jump Game II
dp_tabulation_jumpgame2_v2.png.problem: nums[i] is the max jump length from index i; return the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index (always reachable). Example: [2,3,1,1,4] -> 2 (0->1->4).

dp_interval_burstballoons.png.title: Burst Balloons
dp_interval_burstballoons.png.problem: Bursting balloon i earns nums[left]*nums[i]*nums[right] using its current neighbours (out of bounds counts as 1). Return the max coins from bursting all balloons. Example: [3,1,5,8] -> 167.

greedy_lastindex_partitionlabels.png.title: Partition Labels
greedy_lastindex_partitionlabels.png.problem: Split a string into as many parts as possible so each letter appears in only one part; return the part sizes. Example: 'ababcbacadefegdehijhklij' -> [9,7,8].

dp_statemachine_besttimetobuyandsellstoc.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
dp_statemachine_besttimetobuyandsellstoc.problem: Given daily prices, make as many buy/sell transactions as you like (hold one share at a time), but after selling you must wait one day before buying again. Return the max profit. Example: [1,2,3,0,2] -> 3 (buy, sell, cooldown, buy, sell).

greedy_filter_mergetripletstoformtargett.title: Merge Triplets
greedy_filter_mergetripletstoformtargett.problem: Merging triplets takes the element-wise max. Given triplets and a target, return true if some subset merges exactly into the target. Example: [[2,5,3],[1,8,4],[1,7,5]], target [2,7,5] -> true (merge 1st and 3rd).

greedy_runningsum_gasstation.png.title: Gas Station
greedy_runningsum_gasstation.png.problem: Stations sit in a circle; gas[i] is fuel at station i and cost[i] is fuel to drive to the next one. Return the start index that lets you go all the way around once, or -1. Example: gas=[1,2,3,4,5], cost=[3,4,5,1,2] -> 3.

dp_knapsack_coinchange2.png.title: Coin Change II
dp_knapsack_coinchange2.png.problem: Given coin values (unlimited supply of each) and an amount, count the combinations (order doesn't matter) that add up to the amount. Example: amount=5, coins=[1,2,5] -> 4.

dp_tabulation_interleavingstring.png.title: Interleaving String
dp_tabulation_interleavingstring.png.problem: Return true if s3 can be formed by interleaving s1 and s2 while keeping each string's internal order. Example: s1='aabcc', s2='dbbca', s3='aadbbcbcac' -> true.
